properties.description: Built 2026-10-21 (item 8 of req:small-read-back-faults-from-the-cogito-trial-are-fixed): `silent_on` on Requirement and Constraint (add_requirement / add_constraint), read back on the claim in reasoning_report. properties.name: A principle can say it is silent on a case — neither for nor against — and the read-back shows it
